title: Bottarga Empanadas with Spicy Thai Dipping Sauce
description: A fusion twist on traditional empanadas, featuring the rich and savory flavor of bottarga. Paired with a spicy Thai dipping sauce for added depth.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to desired thickness.
Cut out circles of dough and place a spoonful of bottarga in the center of each.
Brush the edges with a little water and fold the dough in half to form a half-circle.
Press the edges together with a fork to seal.
Brush the tops with a little melted chocolate.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, combine fish sauce, lime juice, and chopped cilantro in a bowl.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine.
Heat the mixture in a saucepan over medium heat until hot and bubbly.
Serve the empanadas with the spicy Thai dipping sauce.
